# Changelog

No version has been published from this checkout. Release notes are maintained in the project changelog and will be linked here when a release is prepared. The current implementation targets the v0.1.0 scope described in the repository brief.

## [v0.1.0] - 2026-10-07

### Added

- Added a Python API and CLI for converting prepared English text into Inflect v2 phonemes and blank-framed token IDs
- Added configurable eSpeak runtime modes and optional pronunciation lexicons with traceable pronunciation hits
